title: OCR Normalization Rules
description: Schema for runtime/OCR_normalization_rules.json. Defines alias tables and ingestion rules used by OCR_result_normalizer.py.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this file was last updated.

issuer_aliases.description: Map of raw OCR text variants to canonical issuer names. Keys are lowercase raw text; values are canonical strings.

location_aliases.description: Map of raw OCR text variants to canonical location names. Keys are partial or variant strings; values are canonical station names.

ocr_ambiguity_handling.description: Configuration for how ambiguous or low-confidence OCR matches are handled.

minimum_confidence_threshold.description: OCR confidence below which a match is flagged for human review.

partial_match_strategy.description: Strategy when a raw OCR string partially matches an alias key.

multi_candidate_strategy.description: Strategy when multiple alias keys match the same raw OCR string.

deduplication_rules.description: Plain-language rules for deduplicating missions ingested from overlapping screenshots.

partial_screenshot_ingestion.description: Rules for handling screenshots where only part of the terminal is visible.

preserve_missing_fields.description: When true, fields not visible in a partial screenshot are set to UNRESOLVED rather than rejected.
